title: Reported small-group picket at Martyrs’ Alley against Russian peacekeepers
protester_groups: Unknown; reported by Rambler as an unknown group

occurrence.evidence: Rambler reports an action at Martyrs’ Alley on the day before its 18 November 2020 article; this is one search-opened report, with the article’s named Kadara.ru origin not independently recovered.

date.evidence: Article date 2020-11-18 and wording that action took place the preceding day support 2020-11-17.

participants.evidence: No attendance estimate reported; cannot establish 50 simultaneously gathered.

demand.evidence: Reported demand was withdrawal of Russian peacekeepers. It is unclear whether the target was Azerbaijan’s decision/policy to host them or Russia as a foreign state.

organizer.evidence: Unknown group; article says city authorities described the participants as provocateurs and said they were not familiar public/political activists.

continuity.evidence: No linked later activity found in targeted December follow-up; October antecedent ownership not fully resolved.

notes: Pending lead only. Neither 50+ simultaneous attendance nor own-country state/policy target is established. The article’s source provenance is not independently verified; do not count as eligible.
